paite: Jotham bel avaihawmpat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm a, anu min Jerushah, Zadok tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jotham / (2 Kum 15.32-38)

paite: Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi. TOUPA tempul ah bel alut kei hi. Himahleh mite'n hoih loutak in ana hih gige uhi.
TOUPA' inn a kongkhak saknungzaw abawl a, huan, Ophel kulh tung ah inn tampi alam behlap lai hi.
Huan Judah tanggam ah khuate abawl a, gamnuai ah inn thupi taktakte, insangte alam lai hi.

Ammon suante'n kumpipa adou ua, azou hi. Huchi in Ammon suante'n huai kum in dangka talent zakhat leh huit buh puak singkhat leh barli buh puak singkhat apia uhi. Huchibang mah in Ammon suante'n akum nihna leh akum thumna ah leng apia uhi.
Huchi in Jotham in TOUPA a Pathian ma a lampi hoih abawl ziak in ahong hatta hi.
Jotham thilhih dangte agaldoute, a-omdante ngai dih, Israel leh Judah kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm hi.
Jotham bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui uh; asik in atapa Ahaz in vai ahawmta hi.
